en: Scott
{player}! You came all the way to the island. I knew you would.
Every Trainer who challenges the Frontier carries one of these. Here, it's yours.
{player} received Scott's Frontier Pass!
The halls here are still being finished. Come and find me at my house in the north-east of the island.

NOTHING
Seven halls stand on this island: the Tower, the Dome, the Palace, the Arena, the Factory, the Pike and the Pyramid.
They are still being made ready. Until they open, Scott sends challengers to the Battle Frontier in Sinnoh.
The Exchange Service Corner, in the east of the island, trades Battle Points for prizes.
The Ranking Hall, in the north-east, shows the best streaks of every hall.
Please enjoy the Battle Frontier!

ENTRY

In the Level 50 battles, a Pokémon above level 50 battles as if it were level 50.
Some very rare Pokémon may not enter, and no two of your Pokémon may be the same species.
No two of your Pokémon may hold the same item. Items from your Bag can't be used in battle.
Good luck in your challenges!
